trace.model.doors.width: camera-free check on p256 (TfW 150256, side three-quarter; s256a/s256b grids at 2x): a 1D projective fit along the bodyside through 8 window edges and the two door centres (residuals 0-25 cm, a pixel being 3-6 cm here) puts the door centres within 0.1 m of the model's but the red door leaves 1.15-1.23 m wide, not 1.76 (the diagram's 1.76 includes the frames each side): drawn 1.22. The fit extrapolates the cab window and cab door 0.2-0.5 m behind the model's; extrapolated, so not applied
trace.liveries.AW.redband: the pinkish-red band sits on the roof's curve above the cantrail: on p256 (band256 grid, 117 px/m from the window glass 2.02-3.11 = 128 px) it is 24 px tall starting 18 px above the side's top: drawn 3.45-3.62 (was 3.30-3.40 on the side, too thin and too low)
trace.liveries.AW.branding: TfW roundel and 'Trafnidiaeth Cymru / Transport for Wales' on p256 (lg150 grid, 3x): 793-890 px along, read through the side fit (s256): 2.67-4.44 m; height 770-818 px at 117 px/m below the glass (2.02 at 718 px): 1.17-1.58 m. Height by width at the artwork's aspect 0.35, as read 0.41: mean 0.38, centred 3.56/1.375. The bilingual 'Cymru a'r Gororau / Wales and Borders' beside it is not in the artwork and not drawn
trace.model.variants.LM.windows: 150/1 window layout checked against the 150/1 diagram (dia1, GWR Class 150-1: cab door 1.30-2.14, windows 3.21-4.99, door 5.65-7.42, 8.08-9.89, 10.24-12.01, door 12.68-14.45, 15.10-16.89, toilet window 18.28-18.99: the same as the model's) and on LNR 150141 (p141, w141 grid): a 1D fit through the window and door fronts (residuals under 12 cm) gives the same layout except that where the diagram has the small toilet window LNR's car has a full window, 17.30-19.21 m (drawn to 19.10, clear of the car end): applied to the LM variant only
trace.liveries.LM.stripes: LNR's streaks on the silver (p141, 150141, st141 grid at 2x): each traced as a polygon in source pixels and mapped along the car through the same 1D fit (window/door fronts, residuals under 12 cm) and up linearly from the cantrail (row 545 = 3.43 m) to the door foot (row 840 = 0.98 m), 120 px/m: a green block over the w2/w3 pillar, a dark tapering streak down that pillar, two short green tapers and a second dark streak below the windows, and a broad slanted green band near the car end. Plain livery shapes (no new option needed); the dots/graded fade of the real streaks not drawn; cab car only, colours green-Bl #507E74 and a near-black #1E2422 (not sampled)
trace.liveries.LM.colours: resampled on p141 (150141, overcast; round-9 render read grey and teal): silver body (985-1010, 730-790) (198,179,151), warm, drawn as the grey of its luminance #B8B8B8 (no neutral on that photo); cab section dark green (705-720, 700-780) #314645 (pBl's green-Bl #507E74 was sunlit); the streaks' and car-end band's green (1140-1155, 720-790) #397A62, the front band the same
trace.model.nose.profile.lower: below the body: the diagrams (150 dia2, 153, 155, 156) draw the cab face flat and vertical down to its lowest painted item, with the headstock, coupler and snowplough under it; there is no sloping chin (the old flatProfile slanted back from 1.05 to 0.55 m at 0.25 m). Now the face runs straight down to 0.912 m (the lowest face item measured head-on) and steps back 6 cm to 0.872, the coupler and plough below as the pipeline draws them
